items.q: Yes, but now, Jonah Jones said to me once that they always thought of Earl Hines as a Western band.

ctx.x: bands in New York played this way like Fletcher Henderson and Chick Webb. It was a different style altogether.

items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Count Basie, you know, with Lester Young and Hershel Evans and Buck and all of them.

ctx.x: Count Basie, you know, with Lester Young and Hershel Evans and Buck and all of them. And finally, when they come in, they opened them at the Roseland, and we went over as a greeter. We played a couple of numbers with the band, you know, with our group, you know.
